---

ZeroHype publishes honest marketing resources for B2B marketers, SDRs, and founders. Everything is diagnostic: find the specific failure point, fix that. Not frameworks, not courses, not communities. Written diagnosis, written fix, specific result.

Anonymous by design. No named founders. The work speaks.

## Free Tools

### Cold Email Roaster
**URL:** https://zerohypelab.com/cold-email-roaster/
Paste your cold email. Get a Hype Score from 0 to 100 based on 71 jargon phrases and 6 analyzers: opener quality, length, I/you ratio, CTA quality, personalization, jargon density. Instant. No signup. Verdicts range from "Suspiciously Human" to "Peak B2B BS."

### Campaign Failure Predictor
**URL:** https://zerohypelab.com/campaign-failure-predictor/
10-question quiz. Score your campaign's failure risk before you launch. Covers ICP clarity, goal definition, channel fit, message, post-click experience, budget, measurement, timeline, learning history, and decision process. Failure Risk Score 0-100. Instant. No signup.

### B2B Bullshit Detector
**URL:** https://zerohypelab.com/bullshit-detector/
Paste any B2B marketing copy. Get a Bullshit Score 0-100, labeled verdict, top offender callouts with reasons, shareable PNG scorecard. Instant. Free. Leads to The Full Autopsy ($97) for annotated written analysis.

### B2B Homepage Roaster
**URL:** https://zerohypelab.com/homepage-roaster/
Enter your homepage URL. Get a score on clarity, CTA strength, jargon density, and conversion readiness.

### 10 People Who Understand German B2B
**URL:** https://zerohypelab.com/german-b2b-experts/
Curated list of 10 real DACH B2B practitioners with deep market expertise and why each one is worth following.

## Pricing FAQ

**Where do I start?**
Marketing Autopsy at $49. Written diagnosis of your B2B marketing position in 48-72 hours. Every other product is downstream of knowing what is actually broken. If you do not know which product you need, start here.

**What is the difference between Marketing Autopsy and Outreach Autopsy?**
Marketing Autopsy: full positioning, messaging, and channel diagnosis. Outreach Autopsy: specifically cold email and LinkedIn outreach sequences. If you are unsure which one you need, start with the Marketing Autopsy.

**When does the Outreach Overhaul make sense over the Outreach Autopsy?**
Autopsy: diagnosis only. Overhaul: diagnosis plus full sequence rewrite. Do not buy the Overhaul without the diagnosis, or you rebuild the same problem with different words.

**Is Revenue Architecture worth $4,500?**
For a B2B business with a structural revenue problem, yes. Two clients per quarter. Application via email required. If you are considering it, email zerohype@proton.me first.

**Are there refunds?**
No. You pay, fill the intake form, receive the written deliverable. If you are unsure, start with the cheapest relevant diagnostic.

## FAQ by audience

**For SDRs:**
If your open rates are above 40% but reply rates are under 3%, you have a message problem, not a deliverability problem. Cold Email Roaster (free) shows the score. Outreach Autopsy ($99) tells you exactly which phrases are the problem.

**For heads of marketing:**
If your team is busy and the pipeline is not moving, the Campaign Failure Predictor (free) diagnoses the structural issue before you invest more. Marketing Autopsy ($49) is the written version for when the campaign already ran.

**For founders running their own outreach:**
If it worked 12 months ago and stopped working, something changed: your ICP shifted, your offer is stale, or your sequence is saturated. Outreach Autopsy ($99) diagnoses which of these it is.

**For new marketing directors (first 90 days):**
The first thing to do is nothing that produces output. The Unfiltered First 90 Days ($49) is the playbook: what to do, what to stop, what to diagnose before you act.
